name: card_hash
notes: input.profile is the normalized Profile (the output shape of clusters_parse_profile); input.ask is dataclasses.asdict(slurm.Ask). `arb submit` fills the Ask before build_plan: partition = profile.default_partition, nodes = 1, mem_gb/cpus = null unless given, walltime_s = parse_walltime(--time), repeat = secrets.token_hex(4) with --repeat. output is sha256(canonical_json(card_payload(...)).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(); the same case ids as card_payload.
